description: Found investigating fz-sc8.238. A program carries the schema of a struct its types name under __struct__. A map whose module atom is computed at run time (Map.put(m, :__struct__, String.to_atom("Elixir.S"))) names a module no type names, so the schema is absent and the map prints as a map; Elixir prints %S{...} because every module is loaded. Closing it means the program carries every struct its source declares, which defines modules nothing calls, against compiling only what is used. Decide the trade before building. Done when: an oracle fixture prints such a map as %S{...} on interp, run and build.
title: A map whose struct module is known only at run time prints as that struct
